Gave this game an honest shot, but it just didn't stick after several hours. The artstyle is lovely, but it's overshadowed by a poor new player experience imo. Either include tutorials/hints to teach players how the game works, or make the systems intuitive. I'm afraid Don't Starve does neither of these. Most of my time in this game was spent either frustrated, confused, or a mix of both. 

If you have the patience and/or enjoy working things out with minimal information, you might like this game. But if your patience is limited and you don't like "wiki games", I would avoid Don't Starve.

This seems to be tailored more for multiplayer, so if you're playing solo, prepare for some weirdness. The game creation process creates a "local server" and is clearly designed to host multiplayer servers. Once you're in, it's painfully boring as single player. There's not even an attempt at bare minimum goal setting or explanation of what anything is. I guess you just wander around and try not to die? Combat is clunky, exploration is boring, and the UI is goofy. Just skip this one unless you have some friends to play with.
